umum.offline: You are offline. Saved pickup codes still open.
umum.tidak_ditemukan_isi: This address does not exist on Jaminin.

demo.penjelasan: Switch to a demo account without a password to show the buyer, seller, and team sides. Reset only deletes orders from demo accounts and sample data.
demo.reset_konfirmasi: Delete all demo account orders and recreate the sample orders?
demo.akun_demo: This is a demo account. Its data can be reset at any time.

akun.sub: Sign in to order, see your orders, and get notified when an order is ready.
akun.reset_terkirim: If that email is registered, a link to set a new password has been sent. Check your spam folder too.
akun.tautan_kedaluwarsa: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

keranjang.kosong_isi: Choose a tenant, then add items.
keranjang.catatan_biaya: A Rp1.000 service fee is added at checkout.
keranjang.ganti_konfirmasi: Your cart has items from {{name}}. One order can only come from one tenant. Empty the cart and start with this tenant?

beranda.sub: Pick a pickup time in 5-minute steps, pay upfront, then collect it yourself at the BINUS @Bekasi canteen.
beranda.jam_istirahat: When do you want to pick up?
beranda.jam_dipilih: Tenants available at {{time}} {{day}} are marked. This time is preselected at checkout.
beranda.kosong_isi: You can still order for tomorrow.
beranda.tidak_ada_jam: No pickup times today or tomorrow

tenant.contoh_isi: The tenant name is real, but the menu, prices, and hours are samples for the prototype.
tenant.jeda: This tenant is temporarily closed. You can still order for a time after it reopens.
tenant.habis_hari_ini_bisa_besok: Sold out for today. You can still order it for tomorrow.

jam.tidak_ada: No pickup times left on this day. Try another day.

status.batas_harian: The tenant's orders for that day are full
status.tutup: The tenant is closed at that time

checkout.jam_ambil_isi: The earliest time already includes 5 minutes to pay, the tenant's order cutoff, and the longest preparation time in your cart.
checkout.habis_hari_ini: An item is sold out for today, so this order can only be picked up tomorrow.
checkout.nama_pengambil_isi: Can be a friend who picks it up. The seller checks this name and the pickup code.
checkout.batas_bayar: You then have 5 minutes to pay. After that the order is cancelled and the time slot is released.

bayar.cara_demo: This prototype does not use real payments yet. Open the Payment Simulator on another device, then enter this code or scan this QR.
bayar.lunas_isi: Your order has been sent to the seller.
bayar.habis_isi: The order was cancelled and the time slot released. You have not paid anything.
bayar.dibatalkan_isi: The order was cancelled before payment.

pesanan.aktif_kosong_isi: Paid orders appear here until they are picked up.
pesanan.tanpa_sinyal: No signal. This is the last pickup code saved on this device.
pesanan.belum_bayar: This order has not been paid.
pesanan.belum_siap_isi: The pickup time has passed and the order is not ready. You can wait or cancel for a full refund.
pesanan.batal_konfirmasi_penuh: Cancel the order? You get a full refund.
pesanan.tunjukkan: Show this to the seller at pickup
pesanan.bagikan_teks: Please pick up my Jaminin order {{number}} at {{tenant}}, {{time}}. Pickup code: {{code}}
pesanan.promo_tidak_bisa_geser: Orders with a promo cannot change time. If you need another time, cancel and order again.
pesanan.wa_teks: Hi, this is {{name}} about Jaminin order {{number}}.
pesanan.wa_contoh: Sample tenants use a sample WhatsApp number.
pesanan.batal_konfirmasi: Cancel the order? You get a full refund.

nilai.isi: Only the seller and the Jaminin team can see it. You can rate once and cannot change it.
nilai.pilih_dulu: Choose Satisfied or Not satisfied first.
nilai.terkirim: Thank you. Your rating was sent to the seller.

struk.unduh_isi: Choose Save as PDF in the print window to keep the receipt.
struk.catatan_simulasi: Payments in this prototype are simulated, not real money transfers.

kalender.isi_acara: Pickup code {{code}}, for {{name}}. Open the order: {{url}}

chat.isi: Messages are visible to the buyer and the seller. The Jaminin team only reads them if the order is reported.
chat.tutup: Chat closes 24 hours after the order is completed or cancelled.

alasan.belum_siap_jam_ambil: Cancelled because it was not ready at pickup time
alasan.semua_menu_habis: Every item in the order sold out
alasan.pembeli_menu_habis: Cancelled by the buyer because an item sold out
alasan.belum_siap_saat_tutup: Not ready before the tenant closed
alasan.tidak_diambil_saat_tutup: Not picked up before the tenant closed
alasan.menu_habis_diganti: Price difference for the replacement item
alasan.jam_khusus: The tenant changed its opening hours

item_status.habis_menunggu: Sold out, waiting for the buyer's choice

menu_habis.isi: {{item}} is sold out. Choose within {{time}}. If you do not choose, it is removed automatically and refunded.
menu_habis.batal_konfirmasi: Cancel the whole order? You get a full refund.
menu_habis.aturan_pengganti: The replacement must cost {{price}} or less. The difference is refunded.
menu_habis.tidak_ada_pengganti: No replacement is available at that price.

geser.isi: You can change the pickup time once, before preparation starts.

laporan.terkirim: Report sent. The Jaminin team will reply on this page.
laporan.cerita_isi: At least 5 characters. Reports are read by the Jaminin team and are not sent to the seller.

profil.nama_isi: Used by the seller to match the pickup.
profil.wa_isi: Indonesian number (08 or +62) or an international number starting with +. No OTP code.
profil.galat_nama: Enter your real name, at least 2 letters.
profil.galat_wa: The WhatsApp number is not valid.
profil.lengkapi_sub: Only once, before your first order.
profil.kabar_isi: Notifications when an order is accepted, starts being prepared, is ready, and a pickup reminder.
profil.kabar_menyala: Notifications are on for this device.
profil.matikan_kabar: Turn off notifications on this device

kabar_hasil.needs_install: On iPhone and iPad, add Jaminin to the Home Screen first, then open it from that icon.
kabar_hasil.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. Try the latest Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
kabar_hasil.denied: Notification permission was denied. Allow it in the browser settings, then try again.
kabar_hasil.mati: Notifications are off on this device.
kabar_hasil.gagal: Could not turn on notifications. Try again shortly.

profil.daftar_tenant_isi: Run a tenant at the BINUS @Bekasi canteen? Register to start receiving orders.

kabar.sub: Updates about your orders and account, newest first.
kabar.kosong_isi: Order updates appear here, even when notifications on your phone are off.
kabar.menu_habis_isi: {{menu}} in order {{nomor}} is sold out. Replace it, remove it, or cancel.
kabar.belum_siap_boleh_batal_isi: Pickup time has passed. You can cancel for a full refund.
kabar.waktu_bayar_habis_judul: Payment time for order {{nomor}} ran out
kabar.waktu_bayar_habis_isi: The order was cancelled and its pickup time released. You can order again.
kabar.tenant_ditangguhkan_isi: Reason: {{alasan}}. Active orders were cancelled with a full refund.
kabar.tenant_diaktifkan_isi: The tenant is visible to buyers again.

pasang.sub: Add Jaminin to your home screen like an app so order notifications arrive.
pasang.sudah: Jaminin is already installed on this device.
pasang.iphone_2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen.
pasang.iphone_3: Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.
pasang.iphone_4: Open Jaminin from the Home Screen icon, then turn on notifications in Profile.
pasang.iphone_catatan: Notifications on iPhone and iPad need iOS 16.4 or later and only work from the Home Screen icon.
pasang.android_isi: If the button above does not appear, open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
pasang.banner_isi: Add Jaminin to your home screen, then turn on notifications in Profile.

pindai.kamera_gagal: The camera could not open. Allow camera access, or type the code.
pindai.arahkan: Point the camera at the QR code.

simulator.sub: Stands in for a banking app in the prototype.
simulator.peringatan: No real money moves. This page uses the same confirmation path that real payments will use later.
simulator.kode_isi: The 6 characters on the buyer's payment page.
simulator.qr_bukan: This QR is not a Jaminin payment QR.

penjual.belum_punya: You do not have a tenant yet
penjual.belum_punya_isi: Register a tenant to start receiving orders, or ask a tenant owner to add you as staff.
penjual.menunggu_isi: The Jaminin team is reviewing the registration. The tenant appears on the home page once approved.

papan.sub: Paid orders, grouped by pickup time.
papan.bunyi_judul: Turn on the new order sound
papan.bunyi_isi: The browser needs one tap before it can play sound.
papan.kode_tidak_ada: That code does not match a ready order today.
papan.kosong_isi: Paid orders appear here with a sound.
papan.habis_konfirmasi: Mark {{item}} sold out in this order? The buyer will be asked to replace it, remove it, or cancel.
papan.riwayat_pembeli: Buyer history at this tenant: cancelled {{cancelled}} times, not picked up {{notPicked}} times.

siap_masak.isi: Orders not ready for pickup yet. Sold-out items waiting for the buyer's choice are not counted.

dapur.sub: Today's orders that are not ready yet, by pickup time. Ready orders move to the Board for handover.
dapur.layar_menyala: The screen stays on while this page is open.
dapur.layar_bisa_mati: The screen may turn off on its own
dapur.layar_bisa_mati_isi: Tap the button below so the screen stays on while the Kitchen page is open.
dapur.layar_tidak_didukung: This browser cannot keep the screen on. Turn off auto-lock in the device settings while cooking.
dapur.kosong_isi: Paid orders for today appear here by pickup time, with the number of portions.
dapur.siap_info: Order {{number}} is ready and moved to the Board for handover.

serahkan.qr_bukan: This QR is not a Jaminin pickup code.

jeda.penjelasan: New pickup times cannot be ordered while paused. Orders already in keep going.
jeda.isi: Buyers cannot order new pickup times from this tenant.

menu.sub_pemilik: Manage items, prices, options, and sold-out items.
menu.sub_karyawan: Mark sold-out items. The owner changes items and prices.
menu.hapus_kategori_tanya: Delete category {{name}}? Its items move to Other.
menu.kategori_kosong: No items in this category yet.
menu.kosong_isi: Add items so buyers can order.
menu.stok_isi: Leave empty for no limit. Counted per pickup date.
menu.pilihan_setelah_simpan: Options (for example spice level or extra cheese) can be set after the item is saved.

pilihan.isi: Example: Spice level (choose exactly 1) or Extras (choose several, with extra cost).
pilihan.galat: Fill in the group name and every option. Maximum must be 1 or more and not less than the minimum.

habis.isi_one: {{count}} paid order includes this item. Notify the buyer so they can replace it, remove it, or cancel.
habis.isi_other: {{count}} paid orders include this item. Notify the buyers so they can replace it, remove it, or cancel.

toko.sub_pemilik: Store details, order rules, schedule, quota, and payout account.
toko.sub_karyawan: Only the owner can change store settings.
toko.kirim_ulang_isi: Fix the details based on the reason above, then resubmit to the Jaminin team.
toko.ditangguhkan_isi: The tenant is hidden from buyers. Contact the Jaminin team.
toko.pengumuman_isi: Shown on the tenant page. Up to 200 characters.
toko.aturan_isi: These set the earliest pickup time and how many orders can come in.
toko.jadwal_isi: You can add more than one range per day, for example 07:00 to 11:00 and 13:00 to 17:00.
toko.setoran_isi: Each day's sales are sent to this account automatically at the payout time.

jadwal.galat_kosong: Add opening hours for at least one day.
jadwal.galat_urutan: Closing time must be after opening time.
jadwal.galat_tumpang: Two ranges on the same day overlap.

libur.isi: For specific dates, such as a day off or a campus event. The weekly schedule stays the same.
libur.catatan_isi: Optional, only visible on this page. Up to 100 characters.
libur.kosong: No days off or special hours yet.
libur.galat_tanggal: Choose today or a later date.
libur.konfirmasi_isi_one: {{count}} paid order on that date has a pickup time outside the new hours. It will be cancelled with a full refund, and the buyer will be notified.
libur.konfirmasi_isi_other: {{count}} paid orders on that date have pickup times outside the new hours. They will be cancelled with a full refund, and the buyers will be notified.
libur.tersimpan_batal_one: Saved. {{count}} order was cancelled with a full refund.
libur.tersimpan_batal_other: Saved. {{count}} orders were cancelled with a full refund.

promo.isi: A discount on the whole order for chosen days and pickup times, paid by the tenant. Promo orders cannot be rescheduled.
promo.nilai_persen_isi: 1 to 90. Rounded down to whole rupiah.
promo.nilai_rupiah_isi: Never more than the food price in the order.
promo.galat_nilai_rupiah: Enter a rupiah discount of 1 or more.
promo.galat_jam: The end time must be after the start time.

kuota.galat_urutan: The end of a quota range must be after its start.
kuota.galat_angka: Quota must be at least 1 order.

angka.cutoff: The order cutoff is more than 120 minutes.
angka.prep: The prep time is more than 60 minutes.
angka.quota: The quota is more than 20 orders per pickup time.

foto.isi: JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 3 MB.
foto.galat_tipe: Use a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo.
foto.galat_besar: The photo is larger than 3 MB.

daftar.sub: Fill this in once. The Jaminin team reviews registrations before a tenant appears on the home page.
daftar.deskripsi_isi: Example: rice, noodles, and cold drinks.
daftar.wa_isi: Buyers use this to contact the tenant.
daftar.jadwal_isi: The last pickup time is 5 minutes before closing.
daftar.kuota_dasar_isi: How many orders you can prepare for one pickup time.
daftar.batas_pesan_isi: Minimum time between payment and the start of preparation. Can be 0.
daftar.kuota_rentang_isi: Optional. Example: lunch 11:00 to 13:00 takes only 2 orders per pickup time.
daftar.menu_isi: At least one item. You can add and change items at any time.
daftar.pilihan_nanti: Options such as spice level are set on the Menu page after registration.
daftar.setoran_isi: Sales are sent daily after a {{fee}} deduction per completed order. In the prototype, this transfer is simulated.
daftar.jam_setoran_isi: Leave empty to use the last closing time of the day.
daftar.syarat_1: Each order deducts {{fee}} from the seller's share. Buyers pay a {{service}} service fee. Neither applies to cancelled orders.
daftar.syarat_2: Paid orders must be prepared for their pickup time.
daftar.syarat_3: Buyers may cancel for a full refund if an order is not ready at its pickup time.
daftar.syarat_4: Sold-out items are marked in the app so buyers can replace, remove, or cancel.
daftar.syarat_5: Refunds the team charges to the tenant are deducted from payouts.
daftar.syarat_draf: Draft terms for the prototype, not yet reviewed by a lawyer.
daftar.setuju: I have read and agree to the seller terms
daftar.galat_nama: Tenant name must be 2 to 60 characters.
daftar.galat_angka: Enter a number of 0 or more.
daftar.galat_kuota: Enter a number of 1 or more.
daftar.galat_menu: Every item needs a name, price, and prep time.
daftar.galat_rekening: Account number must be 4 to 30 digits.
daftar.galat_syarat: Agree to the seller terms first.

setoran.sub_tutup: Sent automatically every day after the last closing time.
setoran.simulasi: In the prototype, payouts are simulated. No real transfer happens.
setoran.kosong_isi: The first payout is sent after an order is completed.

tim.sub: Paid orders by pickup date. Sample data is kept apart from real data.
tim.angka_asli: The cards above count real data only. Revenue counts completed and not-picked-up orders.
tim.kosong: No orders in this range yet
tim.ada_contoh: Rows labeled Sample come from demo sample data.
tim.bukan_tim: This page is for the Jaminin team
tim.bukan_tim_isi: Your account is not a team member.

biaya.isi: Changes apply to new orders only. Existing orders keep the fees from when they were made.

contoh.isi: Deletes the 8 sample tenants with their menus, orders, and payouts. This cannot be undone.
contoh.tanya: Delete every sample tenant and its orders? This cannot be undone.

timpenjual.sub: Review tenant registrations before they appear on the home page.
timpenjual.alasan_isi: Sent to the seller so they can fix the details.
timpenjual.tangguhkan_isi_one: The tenant is hidden from buyers until reactivated. {{count}} paid order from today onward will be cancelled with a full refund.
timpenjual.tangguhkan_isi_other: The tenant is hidden from buyers until reactivated. {{count}} paid orders from today onward will be cancelled with a full refund.
timpenjual.ditangguhkan_ok_one: {{name}} is suspended. {{count}} order was cancelled with a full refund.
timpenjual.ditangguhkan_ok_other: {{name}} is suspended. {{count}} orders were cancelled with a full refund.
timpenjual.diaktifkan_ok: {{name}} is active again and visible to buyers.
timpenjual.tangguhkan_isi_kosong: The tenant is hidden from buyers until reactivated. No paid orders need to be cancelled.

timlaporan.sub: Buyer reports per order. Sellers do not see reports.
timlaporan.wa_teks: Hi, this is the Jaminin team about the report on order {{number}}.
timlaporan.balas_isi: Leave empty to only change the status.
timlaporan.terkirim: Reply saved and the buyer was notified.
timlaporan.uang_terkirim: Refund recorded and the buyer was notified.
timlaporan.batalkan_isi: The order is cancelled with a full refund. The seller deduction is not charged, and the seller is notified.

uangtim.penuh_aktif: For orders still in progress, use Cancel order.
uangtim.penuh_isi: A full refund makes Jaminin return its Rp2.000 share as well.
uangtim.alasan_isi: Recorded for the team. Sellers only see a deduction line in the payout details.

timsetoran.kosong: No payouts in this range yet

anggota.sub_admin: Admins manage team members and fees.
anggota.sub_staf: Only admins can change team members.
anggota.tambah_isi: The person needs a Jaminin account first. Then add them with that account's email.
anggota.hak: Staff can handle sellers, reports, and refunds. Fees and team members are for admins only.

galat.cannot_cancel: This order can no longer be cancelled.
galat.cannot_reschedule: The pickup time can only change before preparation starts.
galat.cart_too_large: The cart has too many items.
galat.daily_limit: The tenant's orders for that day are full.
galat.hours_required: Add opening hours for at least one day.
galat.invalid_option: An option is no longer available.
galat.invalid_option_count: The number of options chosen is not valid.
galat.invalid_subscription: This device cannot receive notifications yet.

galat.item_unavailable: An item is no longer available.

galat.not_pickup_day: Preparation can only start on the pickup day.

galat.not_team: Only the Jaminin team can do this.
galat.not_tenant_member: You are not a member of this tenant.
galat.not_tenant_owner: Only the tenant owner can do this.
galat.note_too_long: Notes can be up to 200 characters.

galat.slot_closed: The tenant is closed at that time. Choose another time.
galat.slot_full: That time just filled up. Choose another time.

galat.slot_unavailable: That time is not available. Choose another time.

galat.cannot_suspend: Only approved tenants can be suspended.

galat.comment_too_long: Comments can be up to 200 characters.
